title: Screenshot Set
description: A set of screenshots with their context and, when the agent rendered them, what it measured. 'rendered' sets come from tools/screenshots.py; 'provided' sets record screenshots people gave the agent. See skills/design-agent/reference/screenshot-review.md.

target.description: The page or URL rendered, or what the provided screenshots show.

w.description: CSS px. For a provided screenshot, image width ÷ pixel density; null if unknown.

pixelDensity.description: e.g. 3 for a phone screenshot at 3×. null = unknown: ask.

method.description: How the text scale was applied, e.g. 'root font-size'.

state.description: Which state it shows: empty, loading, error, signed out…

computedInventory.description: Rendered sets: the measured padding and type of every component, in the audit report's consistencyInventory shape.

measured.description: false = estimated from an image; such a finding is at most major.
